def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import glob
    import re

    paths = [
      "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2023.csv",
      "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2015.csv",
      "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2014.csv",
      "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2016.csv",
      "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2012.csv",
      "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2006.csv",
      "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2007.csv",
      "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2009.csv",
      "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2018.csv",
      "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2011.csv",
      "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2005.csv",
      "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2008.csv",
      "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2020.csv",
      "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2004.csv",
      "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2022.csv",
      "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2021.csv",
      "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2002.csv",
      "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2017.csv",
      "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2013.csv",
      "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2010.csv",
      "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2003.csv",
      "data/environment/input/water-body-testing-2019.csv"
    ]

    files = []
    for p in paths:
        matches = glob.glob(p)
        if not matches:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"No files matched: {p}")
        files.extend(matches)

    def infer_year(path: str) -> int:
        m = re.search(r'(19|20)\\d{2}', path)
        return int(m.group(0)) if m else None

    dfs = []
    for f in sorted(set(files)):
        year = infer_year(f)
        df = pd.read_csv(f, dtype=str)
        df['sourceFile'] = f
        df['year'] = year
        dfs.append(df)

    out = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True, sort=False)
    return out

operators.customDisplayName: Load and vertically concatenate water body testing CSVs for years 2002-2023 from the provided file paths; read each via pd.read_csv(dtype=str); add columns year (parsed 4-digit year from filename) and sourceFile; return combined table

def process(loadAllYears) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = loadAllYears.copy()

    # Use the in-file Year column rather than filename-parsed year (which is all-null)
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')

    # Keep only years in scope and with a known year value
    df = df[df['year'].between(2002, 2023, inclusive='both')].copy()

    # Force year to string to satisfy runtime schema inference expectations
    df['year'] = df['year'].round(0).astype('Int64').astype(str)

    # Normalize key text fields for consistent grouping/filtering
    df['beachName'] = df['Beach Name'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df['beachType'] = df['Beach Type Description'].astype(str).str.strip()

    # Normalize violation to boolean-like string: 'true'/'false'/<NA>
    vnorm = df['Violation'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    df['violationFlag'] = vnorm.map({'yes': 'true', 'no': 'false'})

    return df[['year', 'beachName', 'beachType', 'violationFlag']]

operators.customDisplayName: Fix combined water-body testing table schema: derive numeric year from in-file column Year, filter to 2002-2023 inclusive, then cast year to STRING for runtime compatibility; standardize Beach Name and Beach Type Description (trim); normalize Violation to a string flag violationFlag where {yes->'true', no->'false'} case-insensitive; output columns [year, beachName, beachType, violationFlag]

def process(fixLoadAllYears) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = fixLoadAllYears.copy()

    # Marine beaches only
    marine = df[df['beachType'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'marine'].copy()

    # A beach is unsafe at any point in 2002-2023 if it has at least one violationFlag == 'true'
    # (Rows with missing violationFlag are treated as not-violations, consistent with "no violation at all" intent.)
    marine['isViolation'] = marine['violationFlag'].astype(str).str.lower().eq('true')

    unsafe_beaches = marine.loc[marine['isViolation'], 'beachName'].dropna().unique()
    always_safe_count = int(marine['beachName'].nunique() - len(unsafe_beaches))

    return pd.DataFrame([{'alwaysSafeMarineBeaches2002to2023': always_safe_count}])

operators.customDisplayName: Count marine beaches that had zero violations across 2002-2023 inclusive: filter fixLoadAllYears to beachType=='Marine' (case-insensitive); mark rows with violationFlag=='true' as violations; compute unsafe_beaches as unique beachName with any violation; always-safe count = (# unique marine beachName) - (# unsafe_beaches); return single-row table with alwaysSafeMarineBeaches2002to2023
